Resolves #19252

`DistEsmWorkspaceBoot`'s pack runs inside `withComposedNpmIgnore`, the seam #19223 added for packs that pass `--ignore-scripts`. Since #19223 the `.gitignore` copy is composed in `prepack`, which that flag skips, so the spec packed everything a working tree holds and git ignores and overflowed npm's integrity hash (`ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE: data is too long`). `check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs` was migrated in #19223; this spec was the one left.

Evidence: L2 (the spec run headless at the head on the census tree, plus the unwrapped control on the same tree) → L2 required (test-only). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one import and one wrapped call, mirroring `check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs:343`.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | outside-CI: `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1 …/DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs` at the head, in a tree holding 2.8 GiB of census output under `test/playwright/test-results/e2e/battery` → 4 passed. |
| AC-2 | outside-CI, red-first: dev's spec over the same tree → `beforeAll` fails, `npm error code ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE / data is too long`; restored → green. |
| AC-3 | `git status` clean after both runs; `.npmignore` stays at its 40-line header. |

## Deltas from ticket
None.

## Test Evidence
- The wrapped pack on the census tree: 5,805 entries, 26.8 MiB, no `test-results`, no `.env`, `dist/parse5.mjs` present.
- CI was green at dev `a9abb6c1dc` (run 36230911025) because a CI checkout ignores almost nothing, so no CI job fails at the base; the red reproduces only in a working tree.
